verdict.rationale: Slack documents its own automation capability: Workflow Builder lets any user combine triggers and steps into no-code automations, with conditional branching, and workflows can start from external webhook triggers without a user present. Slack-hosted workflows can also be written in TypeScript with the Deno Slack SDK, and the Events API lets apps react to workspace activity automatically. Missing for 10: scheduled/time-based triggers are not documented here, there is no evidence of AI agents running autonomously in the background (Slackbot routing to agents reads as on-demand), the docs themselves call Workflow Builder's steps and triggers "limited", and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
